backcard_card_name: Frieza, The Emperor Who Swore Revenge
backcard_card_text:
[Permanent] Reduce the skill cost of [Swap] on your yellow <Frieza> cards by (Yellow).
[Auto][Once per turn] When you activate [Swap], draw 1 card.
[Auto][Once per turn] When one of your yellow <Frieza> cards with [Swap] and an energy cost of 3 or more attacks, look at up to 3 cards from the top of your deck, use up to 1 yellow 《Frieza’s Army》 in a combo with its skills negated for the turn, then place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
card_text:
[Permanent] Reduce the skill cost of [Swap] on your yellow <Frieza> cards by (Yellow).
[Auto] If you have 2 or more energy : When you activate [Swap] on one of your yellow <Frieza> cards, you may flip this card to its back side. If you do, draw 2 cards, then add cards from your life to your hand until you have 6 life left.
[Activate : Main][Once per turn] Look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck, add up to 1 {The Return of the Army of Terror} or yellow <Frieza> to your hand, then shuffle your deck.
[Awaken] When your life is at 4 or less : Draw 1 card, then switch up to 1 of your energy to Active Mode.
